d:
Hey everyone!
Finally, here's a new comic that isn't a commission!

This comic was created using the InZoi engine, a Sims-like game that uses Unreal Engine 5.
The game offers a classic Sims mode and a Studio mode for creating scenes.
So, I wanted to test the possibility of making short comics. There will therefore be some minor graphical glitches, unfortunately…

For now, the modding community obviously hasn't added any explicit scenes (only nudity), but that could change later.

So, here's what you can do with InZoi and the tools the game offers.

Enjoy!
